card.name: Ocean floor and polar sea science
card.fires_on: Words inside marine science passages about the deep sea, seafloor, Arctic or Southern Ocean, often a modifier just before a noun like sector, shelf or vents.

modes.label: Modifier before sea feature
modes.description: An adjective such as Atlantic, continental or flashier placed before a noun like sector, shelf or vents.
modes.example: part two, this one bursting from the sea floor of the shallow Arctic<< continental>> shelf.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: A semicolon between author names in a deep-sea paper reference.
modes.example: Kaiser, Stefanie<<;>> Barnes, David; Brandt, Angel
